title: 100,000-row editable financial grid
description: Exercise the actual 19-column Browser 2 workload with deterministic scrolling, sorting, filtering, selection, editing, and live-update phases.

slint.notes: Custom virtualized grid; clipboard uses arboard. Frozen columns are implemented.

qml.notes: Qt TableView with C++ models and custom delegates; frozen columns are not implemented.

fixture.notes: Draft only: Slint and QML generators are not yet verified to produce identical values.

actions.input: Navigate by stable page ID, scroll to versioned source-row IDs, then sort a defined column ascending and descending.
actions.expected: Visible source-row IDs and sort ordering match the scenario oracle.

actions.input: Apply a defined filter, edit a validated numeric cell, copy it as TSV, and undo the edit.
actions.expected: Row counts, edited value, clipboard content, dirty state, and undo state match the scenario oracle.

deviations: The implemented workload has 19 columns; the older performance-spec wording mentions 25.
QML frozen-column behavior is absent and must not be silently removed from parity reporting.
Draft: action oracles, fixture hashes, and clipboard automation are not yet implemented.
